name: Apropos OSK
description:
On-screen keyboard for touch devices, inspired by Windows 11. It has a compact TKL layout with Fn, Ctrl, Alt, AltGr and Super keys. It opens by itself on text fields, can suggest words (built-in or from ibus-typing-booster), moves the cursor when you drag on Space, and has a visual layout editor. It also runs on the lock screen so you can type your password there.

Based on Fluent OSK by TbangIT (https://github.com/TbangIT/fluent-osk).
